name: Pomodoro Restaurant
description_short: Family-run Italian trattoria serving authentic wood-fired pizzas and homemade pasta in the heart of Wilderness.
description_long:
Tucked along George Road in Wilderness, Pomodoro has been serving honest Italian food to locals and visitors for years. The family-run restaurant brings a genuine trattoria feel to the Garden Route, with red-checked tablecloths, warm service, and the unmistakable aroma of wood-fired pizzas coming from their traditional oven.

The menu focuses on Italian classics done properly — hand-stretched pizzas with quality toppings, homemade pasta dishes, and generous portions that reflect the family's approach to hospitality. Their wood-fired pizzas are a local favourite, with a properly blistered crust and fresh ingredients. The calzone and carbonara regularly get mentions from regulars who've been coming back for years.

The relaxed atmosphere works equally well for families with young ones, couples looking for an easy evening out, or groups gathering over shared plates. It's the kind of neighbourhood Italian that Wilderness needed — unfussy, reliable, and genuinely welcoming. The central location makes it an easy stop whether you're staying in town or passing through between Knysna and George.
